title: Bounded Probe Executor + Profile Application Gate v1
summary: Adaptive Engine Profilerが生成したbounded probe planを、予算・並列・retry・失敗上限・checkpoint・resume・human approvalで囲んだcampaignとして実行し、観測結果をProfilerへ返す。Stable profileの適用はruntime mutationではなくreviewable local policy artifactまでに制限する。
original_problem: モデル世代交代への再教育を人手で逐次実行すると時間がかかる。一方でprobeを無制限に並列実行するとAPI費用、重複実行、誤Profile適用、engine drift中の汚染が起こる。
why_it_matters: モデル更新時の身体測定を短時間で一括実行しつつ、費用と失敗をboundedに保ち、A-Fの自己適応ループを実運転可能な形へ近づける。
reason_frozen: unapproved execution、silent truncation、retry cost undercount、resume duplicate、engine mismatch継続、hidden/raw text保存、unstable profile自動適用をDAで禁止するまで実装しない。
preserved_value: campaign fingerprint binds plan tasks and budget
max jobs max attempts max parallel retry failure wall-clock and cost ceilings
worst-case retry cost accounted before execution
checkpoint and resume never rerun completed jobs
engine identity mismatch stops the campaign
observable outcome only; hidden reasoning and raw bodies forbidden
STABLE same-engine profile required for application preview
human approval creates local policy artifact only
trigger_conditions: RTS-FRZ-000016 Adaptive Engine Profiler v1 is COMPLETED
F emits bounded probe plans with observable engine identity
execution can remain adapter-bounded and human-authorized
runtime profile mutation remains outside v1
negative_triggers: provider execution begins without explicit campaign approval
queue silently truncates to fit budget
retries are omitted from worst-case cost/attempt calculation
hidden reasoning raw prompt or raw response is persisted
PROVISIONAL or cross-engine profile is applied
profile artifact mutates runtime routing automatically
possible_destinations: RTS background model behavior campaign worker
future provider-specific adapter behind separate credential gate
